pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-03.png with Read and looked at the lettered art. The page has five panels and no balloons. Panel A, top left: caption 'A later morning: patients can always check in at the front desk.' An elderly man with a cane and glasses stands at the front desk, and the receptionist smiles at her computer. Panel B, top right: caption 'Some check in ahead on the Welbuk Health app.' A young woman in a coral kurta with a ponytail walks outside the clinic and taps a phone showing a calendar check. Panel C, middle left: caption 'Ravi scans the QR code at the door.' A bearded man in a light green shirt with a shoulder bag scans a QR stand with his phone, with the front desk in the background. Panel D, middle right: caption 'A short form on his own phone, shared with consent.' A close-up shows his phone with a form and a check mark beside his profile. Panel E, full-width bottom tier: caption 'Every check-in gets a slot on the screen.' A wall screen carries the label 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12'. The elderly man, the woman and Ravi sit in that order from left to right, Ravi with his phone and his bag on his lap. Reading order: A, B, C, D, then E's caption and screen label.
pages.observation: The order is clear. The art shows the three check-in routes well: the desk, the app and the QR code. The screen label is placed on the TV, so it reads as part of the scene. Ravi is named only in the caption, but his distinctive look carries forward to later pages. The page does not say which slot is Ravi's. The left-to-right seating suggests A-12, and page 04 confirms it. Captions and labels cover no faces or hands. The Panel B caption touches the top and right borders. All text is readable.
